ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with a low global contrast ratio; high-intensity pixels are limited to minute, isolated speckles and high-contrast clusters at the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Absence of contiguous high-contrast macro-blobs or banding; the pigmentation is visually uniform across both lobes, with high-intensity spatial mapping confined to the barnacle-encrusted tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the continuous trailing edge boundary, characterized by irregular pixel-amplitude fluctuations and multiple visible notches of varying depths across both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory sweeping from the central junction to the distal tips, following a clear upward and outward arc.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of high-intensity, roughly circular pixel formations localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, characteristic of barnacle attachment.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of a single distinct, light-colored linear abrasion on the lower medial section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular trailing edge geometry and substantial distal barnacle colonization indicating cumulative environmental interactions and physical wear.
